statement:
theorem H.openFreeShortComplex_shortExact {X : Scheme.{u}} (U V : X.Opens)
    (hc : U ⊔ V = ⊤) : (H.openFreeShortComplex U V).ShortExact

proof.text: Construct the pullback square of the intersection and the two opens mapping to the top open. The cover hypothesis makes its two arrows a covering sieve. Apply Mathlib MayerVietorisSquare.mk_of_isPullback and shortComplex_shortExact; its signed complex is definitionally the constructed free-sheaf complex.
